title: Relaxed Free-Throw Wind-Down
description: Pairs shoot free throws at a walking pace with a fixed routine, finishing practice on a calm, positive note while heart rates settle.

content.objective: Lower the heart rate while finishing on a positive, low-pressure shooting routine.
content.setup: Two or three players at each basket. One shoots free throws while a partner rebounds and passes the ball back at a walking pace.
content.organization: Use every available basket. Rotate roles after every five shots, so each player shoots, rebounds and passes in turn.
instructions: Take one deep breath, then shoot using the same routine every time: bounce, breathe, shoot.
The shooter takes five free throws, walking to the line rather than jogging.
The partner rebounds, walks the ball back and makes a chest pass to the shooter.
Swap roles after five shots and keep a running total for each pair.
After three rounds, walk one slow lap and stretch calves and shoulders.
coachingPoints: Use the same routine on every shot.
Follow through and hold the finish until the ball lands.
commonMistakes: Rushing the routine because practice is almost over.
Passing the ball back hard so the shooter has to catch on the move.
Standing still and cold between shots instead of walking to stay loose.
content.safety: Keep the area under each basket clear and walk, do not run, when fetching a loose ball.
progressions: Pairs try to beat their total from the last session.
regressions: Move one step closer to the basket for players who are struggling with range.
variations: Each make earns the partner a 10-second stretch held by the shooter.
